verdict.rationale: Jira exposes a REST API that developers use directly (jira-comm-11, jira-comm-14) and Atlassian provides an official MCP server for agent integration (jira-probe-3), but there is no evidence of official language SDKs, and openapi/llms.txt discovery probes both failed (jira-probe-1, jira-probe-2), suggesting weak first-class SDK support for AI-native builders.
